brief:
Thirteen students in Gaza have been left unable to pursue university scholarships in Belgium after the country's government failed to agree on an evacuation plan, The Guardian reported. The students said they were devastated by the decision, which prevents them from leaving Gaza to take up their places at Belgian universities.

The Belgian government's inability to reach consensus on the evacuation has stranded the scholarship recipients. No details were provided on the specific obstacles preventing the government from authorizing the students' departure or timeline for potential resolution.

title: Belgian government blocks scholarship evacuation for Gaza students
